strategy.observation: GitLab has published 177 consecutive monthly releases, which suggests a constant need to produce and update release notes and upgrade documentation.
strategy.offer_link: Contract technical writers could help absorb the recurring release-notes and migration-guide workload that comes with a monthly release cadence, especially when the documentation team needs to keep pace without slowing product shipping.
hypotheses: The documentation team may be spending significant time on release notes and upgrade/migration guides.
Some releases may require customer-facing migration guidance beyond standard release notes.
Your team may want temporary help to prevent documentation bottlenecks during release cycles.
strategy.angle: GitLab’s 177 straight monthly releases probably keep your documentation team on a permanent release-notes treadmill.
strategy.fit_reason: A steady monthly release cadence makes contract technical writers a plausible fit, because release notes are repetitive, time-sensitive, and easy to staff externally when the volume is continuous.

draft.body:
